Welcome back shift leads,
Staff rotas came up after lunch, so just a quick note

Please keep the handover calm and steady, especially on mixed-species routes where a little extra check-in goes a long way. The Companion Animal Travel Desk is keeping a close eye on special assistance notes, and every animal is getting patient attention from trained staff. 

For the Windmere files, <<FACT F047>> sits alongside the normal boarding notes, so please read the full file before you confirm anything. <<FACT F120>> if a traveler mentions an in-transit problem, and keep the tone reassuring so nobody feels rushed. We are treating each journey as a shared responsibility, and the desk team is ready to support you if anything needs a second look.

On Starling services, <<FACT F051>> should be taken as the working rule, and that helps us stay consistent across the board. Thanks for staying flexible and keeping the animals, travelers, and crew settled.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
